articles.title: PBCO Financial (PBCO) Stock Price Stays Guarded After Q3 Earnings
articles.summary: PBCO Financial just posted its Q3 2026 scorecard and the headline is simple. Earnings per share came in at US$0.52 on revenue of US$10.234 million, yet the stock only edged up about 0.7% today after a weaker run over the past month and quarter. That muted bounce suggests sentiment is cautious, while the income statement looks steadier. The market is still anchored to recent share price softness. The fundamentals are telling a calmer story.
